description:
What happened in the workspace, and what came of it.
view:
- log(limit?): What Sightkick, the owner and agents did, newest first.
- events(after?, types?, limit?): What to act on, oldest first (reply_received, citation_lost, page_dropped, check_back_done, change_lost, competitor_pages). Pass the cursor back as `after` for only new ones. Without it, the last 7 days.
- report: The weekly report's numbers and a draft for the owner (under 300 words): AI answers week on week, Google over 28 days, what was published, changed and pitched, what's for the owner to do. Lead with the outcome.
- receipt(improvementId?, articleId?, changeId?): What one change did, on Google (clicks before and after) and in AI answers (citations before and after): an improvement, a published page or a change you logged.
name: get_activity
title: Get the activity
